onprem-tester.tests: End-to-end acceptance of a Device Management install
onprem-tester.readme: The end-to-end acceptance test of a Device Management installation. One Docker image holds the compiled example clients, the API smoke tester, manifest-tool and the pytest steps; `testall` runs them in order against the API address it is given: API smoke, certificates, update preparation, client builds, developer-mode clients over TCP, UDP and IPv6, firmware update over HTTP and CoAP, the factory flow (FCU download, factory configurator client, factory-mode clients), device events and device deletion. [tested_features.md](tested_features.md) lists what each step proves.

ledger.note: k3s-golden: run cases 497 incl. 472 API smoke subcases; 96% pass. FCU /downloads/fcu 404: 12 fail (api-smoke 10, install_fcu 1, device_events prod device 1) + 18 not run (install_fcu 7, fcc-runner 1, fcu-client-runner 5, fcu-client-udp-runner 5). Firmware image URL http://minio-api.staging-shared.local unreachable from the device, campaign autostopped: 2 fail (update HTTP, update CoAP test_02) + 4 not run. Billing routes 401 to tier 99 (/v3/service-packages, -quota, -quota-history GET): 3 fail. DELETE /v3/accounts/{id} unsupported-method check gets 404 where the smoke expects 405: 1 fail. No global IPv6 in the Docker bridge: 6 skipped (IPv6 build 1, IPv6 runner 5). Developer device deleted (204); 3 unenrolled smoke device records per run stay (cloud: 400, developer-certificate devices only).; offline: developer client build in the container; factory and factory-configurator clients prebuilt in the image (2 skipped as present); staging: not run: the suite writes on every stage (certificates, devices, campaigns, API smoke POST/PUT/DELETE); the operator put staging out of scope
